fullDetail.title: Full Exterior & Interior Detail
fullDetail.description: Professional detailing service that transforms your vehicle inside and out with comprehensive cleaning and protection.
features: Paint surface decontamination (removes tar, sap, and bonded contaminants)
Interior deep cleaning (vacuuming, carpets, seats, vents, trims)

ceramicCoating.title: Ceramic Coating Package
ceramicCoating.description: Includes Full Exterior & Interior Detail plus professional-grade ceramic coating for ultimate protection.
features: Professional-grade ceramic coating applied to all painted surfaces
Hydrophobic protection for easier washing and water beading
Enhanced gloss and depth of paint color
Long-lasting protection against UV rays, dirt, and contaminants

paintCorrection.title: Paint Correction Package
paintCorrection.description: Complete paint restoration service with multi-stage correction, ceramic coating, and comprehensive detailing.
features: Professional-grade ceramic coating applied to all painted surfaces
Multi-stage paint correction (machine polishing to restore clarity)
Swirl mark, oxidation & light scratch removal
Ceramic coating application for added protection and shine
